sql: select (select state from experiments where key='mmsell-price-ceiling-capacity') as successor_state, (select count(*) from experiment_deployments ed join experiment_epochs ee on ee.id=ed.epoch_id join experiment_versions ev on ev.id=ee.version_id where ev.experiment_id=(select id from experiments where key='mmsell-price-ceiling-capacity') and ed.kind='live' and ed.ended_at is null) as live_deployments, (select count(*) from live_orders where strategy like 'Dmmsell10%') as dmmsell10_orders, (select count(*) from paper_trades where strategy='mmsell10' and created_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-02 08:25:39+00' and status in ('settled','closed_sl','closed_tp','closed_timeout')) as settled_v3, (select count(*) from paper_trades where strategy='mmsell10' and created_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-02 08:25:39+00') as created_v3, (select count(*) from mmsell_candidate_ticks where captured_at > now() - interval '10 minutes') as cands_10m, now()::text as now_utc
